entities.name: Master Information Block
entities.description: Always transmitted on BCH with 80 ms periodicity. Contains parameters needed to acquire SIB1 from the cell. First transmission scheduled in subframes as defined in TS 38.213.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: Transmitted on DL-SCH with 160 ms periodicity. Contains information about availability and scheduling of other SIBs, including on-demand SIB configuration. Cell-specific SIB.

entities.name: System Information Message
entities.description: Carries SIBs other than SIB1 and posSIBs on DL-SCH. Transmitted within periodically occurring SI-windows. Only SIBs with same periodicity mapped to same SI message.

entities.name: System Information Window
entities.description: Periodically occurring time domain windows where SI messages are transmitted. Same length for all SI messages, non-overlapping between different SI messages.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration Message
entities.description: Used by network to provide system information through dedicated signaling for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED state, particularly when UE has no common search space configured.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED State
entities.description: UE state where network can provide system information through dedicated signaling using RRCReconfiguration message.

entities.name: schedulingInfoList
entities.description: Configuration that maps SIBs to SI messages. Works together with schedulingInfoList2 for SIB mapping and posSchedulingInfoList for posSIB mapping.

entities.name: PSCell System Information
entities.description: Required SI for PSCell provided by dedicated signaling. Can only be changed with Reconfiguration with Sync. UE must acquire MIB of PSCell for SCG SFN timing.

entities.name: SCell System Information
entities.description: Required SI for SCells provided by dedicated signaling. Network releases and adds concerned SCell upon change of relevant SI.

relations.description: MIB includes parameters needed to acquire SIB1 from the cell
SIB1 includes information regarding availability and scheduling of other SIBs mapped to SI messages
Each SI message is transmitted within periodically occurring SI-windows
Mapping of SIBs to SI messages is configured in schedulingInfoList and schedulingInfoList2
For UE in RRC_CONNECTED, network can provide system information through RRCReconfiguration message
Network provides required SI for PSCell by dedicated signaling within RRCReconfiguration message
Network provides required SI for SCells by dedicated signaling within RRCReconfiguration message
UE shall acquire MIB of PSCell to get SFN timing of the SCG
